convention: metres from KPBI (26.6832, -80.0956): north_m=(lat-26.6832)*111320, east_m=(lon+80.0956)*111320*cos(radians((lat+26.6832)/2)); images north-up, row 0 = n1 (north edge), column 0 = e0 (west edge); world x=east, z=north
source: USGS The National Map USGSImageryOnly tile cache (NAIP orthoimagery; Blue Marble/Landsat at small scales), Web Mercator tiles resampled to the local grid; transparent (no-data) areas filled with NASA Blue Marble: Next Generation via NASA GIBS. Water masks: imagery no-data + blue near-shore ocean + USGS NHD water polygons (near); Natural Earth 10m land/islands/lakes (far).
